models: Esquire (the 'Born to Run' guitar, a hybrid Tele
guitar.evidence: Springsteen's battered Telecaster/Esquire hybrid is one of the most iconic guitars in rock, featured on countless album covers.

tone.target: dry arena rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: dry arena rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A punchy, mid-focused signal chain using a Boost for initial grit, followed by the UK 45 amp model into a vintage 4x12 cab, enhanced with Chorus for width and minimal Room reverb for space.

blocks.gap: The Boost module provides enough grit; adding a dedicated distortion might muddy the punchy mids.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Plexi/Marshall sound required for arena rock crunch and forward mids.
blocks.gap: None. This model is ideal for British rock tones.
